propositions: When an LLM call is blocked by content policy (Bedrock Guardrail or model refusal), the operator message incorrectly reports 'too large / malformed' instead of naming the actual cause.
The resolution_class CHANGE_INPUT is correct and should remain unchanged; only the message text needs refinement.
message_for() must accept an optional finish_reason parameter and return a distinct content-filter-aware message when resolution_class==CHANGE_INPUT and finish_reason=='content_filter'.
The finish_reason value must be threaded through from LLMOutcome.diagnostic and persisted coverage diagnostic to all message_for() call sites.
Non-content-filter CHANGE_INPUT cases (e.g. HTTP 413) must continue to receive the generic message to avoid over-broadening.
Backward compatibility must be maintained: message_for() calls with only resolution_class string must default to generic message.
